title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
subtitle: A third traveller steps out of a book
summary: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam is AlphaDream's Nintendo 3DS role-playing crossover between Mario & Luigi and Paper Mario. body: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam is AlphaDream's Nintendo 3DS role-playing crossover between Mario & Luigi and Paper Mario. Luigi opens a book containing a paper world, releasing its inhabitants into the Mushroom Kingdom. Mario and Luigi join Paper Mario to rescue two versions of Princess Peach from two collaborating Bowsers. The premise gives the familiar travelling pair another playable companion with a distinctly different body. The humour of meeting a paper counterpart is also a design opportunity, because the new arrival can reach places and perform actions unavailable to the other two.

Each member of the trio has a separate control button during exploration and timed battle actions. Paper Mario's thin body can squeeze through narrow gaps, while new shared moves gradually expand what the group can reach. Combat continues to combine turn-based choices with precise inputs for attacking and avoiding incoming blows. The additional traveller makes those sequences more involved without discarding the series' basic language. The player learns to recognise who needs to act, using the differences between the three characters to give an ordinary movement or attack another arrangement.

Selected encounters place the heroes on large papercraft figures that fight in an open arena, turning a fragile material into the basis of an oversized battle. Elsewhere, finding hidden Paper Toads gives the surrounding areas another task to support. Battle Cards add effects that can change the conditions of an encounter as the adventure progresses. Paper Jam uses the crossover most directly when the material difference becomes an action: a body fits through a gap, a group coordinates a move or a constructed figure changes the scale of the fight.
